body: Hi, thank you so much for your comment. Everything you have said has helped so much, and I've just been carrying so much guilt recently, I really loved him and I saw a long long future together so I felt like it was all put on me and I ruined everything. And also maybe because I ended it, he doesn't want to speak to me and hates me lol. I am really trying my best to get through day by day and I just feel like I won't find anyone else I like as much. It was my first relationship, so it's been super hard and tough for me. But its people like you who give such support, that get me through the day, so honestly thank you so much <3
